information_updates.finding: 70953 provides a useful solver-validation source through controlled low-Reynolds-number sphere motion in a rotating fluid, where terminal velocity changes with angular speed due to Coriolis effects.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 70953 is the repository identifier, not a measured fluid quantity.

information_updates.finding: The 2026 X-ray-shielding review links nanocomposite attenuation performance to high-Z filler chemistry, particle size, dispersion and composite architecture and should inform Worldshepherd radiation-protection materials screening.
The focus-induced photoresponse paper supplies a ranging/sensor principle in which detector response varies with focus and can encode object distance.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 27475 occurs in the DOI, not as the measured distance.
